translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: to only the people present here.」

translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: 「その為に皆だけ呼びました」

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: 「No, most of the thefts were done by the crow.

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: the same crime of theft in different places.
